FAQs

Is registration free?

Yes. Entry is free.

Is registration compulsory?

Yes. You need to register to attend.

Who can attend?

Newly entered (2026 batch) medical students from the Warangal Zone colleges listed on this page.

What is the purpose of the event?

To appreciate your efforts and help you begin your journey with proper guidance.

What should I expect?

CPR, Tarbiyah, academic guidance, quizzes and networking, along with the felicitation.

Where and when is it?

29 November 2026, 9:30 AM – 2:00 PM, Warangal. The exact venue is to be announced.
